traceability.notes: Story docs/stories/003.0-DEV-FUNCTION-ANNOTATIONS.story.md is a concrete implementation specification for two ESLint rules: traceability/require-story-annotation and traceability/require-req-annotation. The implementation in src/rules/require-story-annotation.ts and src/rules/require-req-annotation.ts, backed by shared helpers and annotation-checker, matches all listed requirements: both rules enforce their respective annotations on the same function-like constructs (FunctionDeclaration, FunctionExpression, MethodDefinition, TSDeclareFunction, TSMethodSignature) while excluding arrow functions by default; they share configurable scope and exportPriority semantics; they use a common, well-tested JSDoc/comment parsing strategy with robust edge-case handling; they provide clear, precise, and actionable error messages at the function identifier; and they fully support TypeScript-specific constructs. Targeted Jest runs for all Story 003.0-related tests (9 suites, 91 tests) and prior full test runs all pass with no failures. Documentation for require-story-annotation explicitly references this story and describes behavior and configuration consistent with the implementation and tests. Based on this concrete evidence, all acceptance criteria and technical requirements for this story are fully satisfied.
